source.title: Embracing the Elements
source.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.
source.objective: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.
